provenance.supplemental_plot_method: Read source Channel3, plot complete existing heart_rate_run plus up to 0.4 s context and existing candidate peak indices. decision_semantics.accept: Retain existing automated eligibility, including invalidity, under the conditional rate and existing exclusions. Does not certify every beat or supply missing measurements.
decision_semantics.reject: Exclude an otherwise automated-eligible signal on specific contradictory evidence.
decision_semantics.uncertain: Retain unresolved uncertainty and withhold reviewed physiology eligibility for the affected signal or timebase scope.
decision_semantics.timebase_uncertain_scope: Withhold trial-level physiology in dependent reviewed analyses. Keep conditional source outputs and self-report eligibility intact. Requires a separately documented provenance or method resolution to restore.
decision_semantics.ecg_and_rmssd: HR and primary RMSSD eligibility remain separate; 10/20 s RMSSD sensitivities do not replace primary 30 s RMSSD.

limitations: AI research reviewer; no human owner signature, clinical qualification claim, diagnosis or verification of NN beats.
